B21.title: 通用幂等任务参考服务
B21.boundary_and_ownership: One domain-neutral idempotent task-service reference application, no ArcForges business dependency.
B21.native_reuse: SQLx/SeaQuery and selected Rust host; use native transaction/relations/streaming implementation from B04/B14/B17.
B21.csharp_surface: Typed Task/Attempt/Lease entities, Fluent queries and C# Handler business logic on mandatory Rust DB/ORM/Server.
implementation_steps: Define deterministic schema/migrations and API operation semantics including idempotency key, CAS version and retryable outcomes.
Implement create/claim/complete/query flows with explicit transaction boundaries and native-backed typed Fluent calls.
Handle conflict CTE snapshot using a new statement when necessary; reconcile durable result after COMMIT Unknown before retry.
Exercise request/body/DB result streaming and correlation through C# Handlers, never Kestrel hosting.
Supply independent NuGet consumer profiles for SQLite and real PostgreSQL, including ordinary app model/Handler edits.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: ACK loss never blindly repeats a non-idempotent mutation; Unknown retained until durable reconciliation.
Cancelled request cannot free live DB transaction/body owners; scope drains actual operations before release.
specific_acceptance: Real HTTP→C# Handler→Rust ORM/DB response on Windows/Linux AOT for both databases.
Concurrent duplicate requests, conflict snapshot, crash/restart and durable reconciliation; native hash unchanged across ordinary entities.
B21.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

B22.title: 端到端故障、崩溃与长期资源验证
B22.boundary_and_ownership: End-to-end failure/crash/soak correctness and bounded resource accounting of exact product composition.
B22.native_reuse: Real PostgreSQL/SQLite/native HTTP/TLS stack, process control and protocol fault proxy.
B22.csharp_surface: External fault driver and durable-data oracle; no in-process mock substitutes for server/database failures.
implementation_steps: Inject lost COMMIT replies, failed transactions, early stream exit, slow readers, network reset, handler faults and shutdown races.
Reconcile database effects and session identity/state independently; differentiate rollback queued/acknowledged and worker retirement.
Run repeated load/drain/idle cycles and fixed-duration long workload with live owners/roots/permits/thread/RSS trends.
Record failure seed/timeline/build/DB identity and minimized reproduction; require no silent data loss/duplicate side effects.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: External timeout or process termination cannot be counted as graceful retirement.
Flat RSS is not proof of no leak; leaked owner counters fail even when allocator returns no memory to OS.
specific_acceptance: All reference operations with real PG and SQLite plus native HTTP1/2/TLS on both AOT OS.
Crash recovery, Unknown reconciliation, exhausted budget and shutdown liveness; explicit test duration/load and resource thresholds based on design limits.
B22.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

B23.title: 领域全负载性能与内存报告
B23.boundary_and_ownership: Complete workload performance/memory/developer-cost report for actual accepted reference artifacts.
B23.native_reuse: Direct Rust Engine and equivalent C# AOT comparator including Kestrel only in comparator executable.
B23.csharp_surface: Reproducible comparison report and raw dataset; no product-host selection vote.
implementation_steps: Use A21 controller with B21 applications and B22 correctness oracles; keep DB durability/TLS/serialization/query semantics equal.
Measure cold/warm, small/large payload, low/high concurrency, streaming and overload with raw histograms and repeated processes.
Attribute FFI/DTO/copy/managed/native allocation and runtime threads, plus RSS/working set/package/build/application edit costs.
Report adverse/unsupported cells and confidence intervals; propose optimisations only with source/lifetime tradeoff and repeatable benefit.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Invalid functional oracle, unequal workload or generator saturation invalidates benchmark.
Do not declare Rust faster from a microbenchmark, language name or single favourable percentile.
specific_acceptance: All three routes with pinned binaries/config/data on Windows/Linux where equivalent; missing route explicitly explained.
Predeclared regression bands grounded in baseline/noise, no guessed percentage target; raw data independently reviewed.
B23.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.

B24.title: 领域兼容矩阵、独立包与发布验收
B24.boundary_and_ownership: Final immutable domain release matrix and independent package acceptance; all existing domain components included.
B24.native_reuse: Same selected mature Rust closure and D10 provenance; no alternate Kestrel product profile.
B24.csharp_surface: Versioned Data/Query/Server plus optional-to-consumers gRPC/MCP packages over one mandatory Rust host.
implementation_steps: Bind all B01–B23 accepted component revisions and A16/A22 package/compatibility outcomes to one release scope.
Run clean Windows/Linux consumers: SQLite and real PG, HTTP1/2/TLS, chosen gRPC/MCP packages independently and combined.
Verify no-Rust ordinary build/run/edit and explicit Native AOT publication/execution with byte-identical native module for model/Handler changes.
Audit licenses/transitive artifacts/provenance/ABI/behavior versions and rollback set; publish only after actual future release authorization.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: A research/design accepted contract is not a product evidence row; every actual release component needs its own verified result.
Missing mandatory B04/B17, implicit managed driver/host fallback, unknown profile or stale digest blocks release.
specific_acceptance: Exact final source/native/NuGet/AOT artifact hashes, real DB/network fault/soak and performance evidence on both OS.
Independent NuGet isolated consumption, old/new upgrade/downgrade and incompatible ABI/native asset negative; all 23 domain component revisions pinned.
B24.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.
